# Test fixtures

`munich_altstadt_excerpt.osm` is **real OpenStreetMap data** (see the last bullet); every other file in
this folder is **synthetic**: generated by map-builder's test helpers, not real geographic data.

* `synthetic_area.osm`: hand-built OSM XML (generator "map-builder SYNTHETIC test fixture").
  It covers buildings (gabled, hipped, courtyard, `building:part`, `min_height`), roads, a
  bridge (reported as unsupported) and a road tunnel (way/1072, generated as a tube), water, trees and an invalid bow-tie
  outline. The node coordinates are placed near 47.0°N 8.0°E for convenience only. They do
  not describe that real location.
* `synthetic_dem.asc`: ESRI ASCII grid of an analytic sloped/undulating surface (vertical
  datum reported as `SYNTHETIC`).

The synthetic files contain no OpenStreetMap or Copernicus data and need no licence.
`examples/synthetic_sample.mbmap` is built from them with a fixed `--created-utc`, so the build is
byte-reproducible. The exact command is in [examples/README.md](../../examples/README.md), and
`tests/test_examples.py` fails if the committed sample goes stale. The build passes `--osm-license` so the sample is not credited as OpenStreetMap/ODbL.

* `munich_altstadt_excerpt.osm`: an excerpt (OSM ways near two spots plus a few chosen ways, user/changeset metadata stripped) of the 400 x 400 m area of `tools/demo/presets/munich-altstadt.json`, fetched from Overpass on 2026-11-19. (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright. It carries the same attribution in its `<note>` element and is used only by `tests/test_real_data_munich.py`. It contains no Copernicus data.
